sn2.8:1.1: Atha kho Tāyano devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Tāyano devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.8:2.1: Chinda sotaṃ parakkamma || kāme panuda brāhmaṇa || nappahāya muni kāme || n-ekattam upapajjatīti || ||
sn2.8:3.1: Kayirañ ce kayirath' -enaṃ || daḷham enaṃ parakkame || sithilo hi paribbājo || bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ || ||
sn2.8:4.1: Akatam dukkataṃ seyyo || pacchā tapati dukkataṃ || kataṃ ca sukataṃ seyyo || yaṃ katvā nānutappati || ||
sn2.8:5.1: Kuso yathā duggahīto || hattham evānukantati || sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭham || nirayāyūpakaḍḍhati || ||
sn2.8:6.1: Yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ || saṅkiliṭṭham ca yaṃ vataṃ || saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ || na taṃ hoti mahapphalan ti || ||
sn2.8:7.1: Idam avoca Tāyano devaputto || idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
sn2.8:8.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi || || Imaṃ bhikkhavo rattiṃ Tāyano nāma devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā mam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Tāyano devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.8:9.1: Chinda sotam parakkamma || kāme panuda brāhmaṇa || nappahāya muni kāme || n-ekattam upapajjati ||
sn2.8:10.1: Kayirañce kayirath-enaṃ || daḷham enaṃ parakkame || sithilo hi paribbājo || bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ ||
sn2.8:11.1: Akataṃ dukkataṃ seyyo || pacchā tapati dukkataṃ || kataṃ ca sukataṃ seyyo || yaṃ katvā nānutappati ||
sn2.8:12.1: Kuso yathā duggahīto || hattham evānukantati || sāmaññaṃ dupparāpaṭṭham || nirayāyūpakaḍḍhati ||
sn2.8:13.1: Yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ || saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ ca yaṃ vataṃ || saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ || na taṃ hoti magapphalan ti || ||
sn2.8:14.1: Idam avoca bhikkhave Tāyano devaputto || idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyi || Uggaṇhātha bhikkhave Tāyanagāthā || pariyāpuṇātha bhikkhave Tāyanagāthā || atthasaṃhitā bhikkhave Tāyanagāthā ādibrahmacariyikāti || ||
